title: Decision tree evaluation
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree with alphabet $\Omega$ and labels $\alpha$, and let $x\in\Omega^n$ be an input. Its evaluation returns the label at a leaf; at a query of coordinate $i$, it follows the child indexed by $x_i$ and evaluates that child on the same input.
